verdict.rationale: VLP's Emerging Growth Companies & VC practice page explicitly states it advises on 'entity formation, capitalization, corporate governance, equity compensation' for start-ups, directly matching the incorporation/formation story, and related pages (equity comp, exec comp) reinforce founder stock and governance work. Missing for 10: explicit mention of charter/bylaws drafting, initial board consent preparation, or a dedicated founder stock purchase agreement service, and no client testimonials/case studies confirming actual delivery of a full incorporation package.
